title: Implement ManaAPI Facade Class
objective: Create the main public API facade that provides mod integration points for mana operations. This class exposes a unified interface for querying, modifying, gathering, and flowing mana using the existing pure Java components.

getMana.signature: public static double getMana(int x, int y, int z)
getMana.returns: The mana value at the specified world coordinates, or 0.0 if position is unset or invalid
getMana.contract: Never throws; returns non-negative finite value; coordinates are any integer

setMana.signature: public static void setMana(int x, int y, int z, double value)
setMana.contract: Sets mana at coordinates; non-positive or invalid values remove the position; coordinates are any integer; value must be finite

addMana.signature: public static double addMana(int x, int y, int z, double delta)
addMana.returns: The new mana value at the position after adding delta
addMana.contract: Non-finite deltas are ignored; result is clamped to non-negative; returns finite non-negative value

gatherMana.signature: public static double gatherMana(int centerX, int centerY, int centerZ, int radius, double maxTotal)
gatherMana.returns: The total mana gathered from the spherical region
gatherMana.contract: Radius must be non-negative; maxTotal must be positive and finite; gathers from positions within inclusive Euclidean sphere; never produces negative mana at any position; returns value in range [0, maxTotal]

flowMana.signature: public static double flowMana(int ax, int ay, int az, int bx, int by, int bz, double maxTransfer)
flowMana.returns: The amount of mana moved from higher to lower concentration
flowMana.contract: maxTransfer must be positive and finite; mana flows from higher to lower; conserves total mana; returns value in range [0, maxTransfer]

getConfig.contract: Never returns null; returns immutable configuration

setConfig.contract: Config must not be null; config must pass validation

ManaAPI.behavior: All methods are static; class is final and non-instantiable; all operations are thread-safe through delegation to underlying sparse storage

semantics.getMana: Reads from ChunkManaMap; unset positions return 0.0
semantics.setMana: Writes to ChunkManaMap; non-positive values cause removal to maintain sparsity
semantics.addMana: Delegates to ChunkManaMap.add; handles overflow by clamping to Double.MAX_VALUE
semantics.gatherMana: Delegates to SphericalGatherer.gather with deterministic iteration order (X, then Y, then Z)
semantics.flowMana: Delegates to FlowEngine.flowPair; uses GradientCalculator to determine direction
semantics.getConfig/setConfig: Manages a singleton ManaConfig instance; setConfig validates before assignment

invalid_input_behavior.getMana: No invalid input possible - all integer coordinates are valid; returns 0.0 for unset
invalid_input_behavior.setMana: Non-positive values remove position; non-finite values remove position; no exception thrown
invalid_input_behavior.addMana: Non-finite delta is ignored (no-op); result clamped to non-negative
invalid_input_behavior.gatherMana: Negative radius returns 0.0; non-positive or non-finite maxTotal returns 0.0
invalid_input_behavior.setConfig: Null config throws NullPointerException; invalid config throws IllegalArgumentException

deterministic_ordering.gatherMana: Iteration order is deterministic: X from (centerX-radius) to (centerX+radius), then Y, then Z; positions visited in this order are drained in that sequence
deterministic_ordering.flowMana: Direction determined by GradientCalculator which uses consistent signum logic; source/target selection is deterministic based on mana comparison
deterministic_ordering.all_operations: All operations produce identical results for identical inputs; no randomness or non-deterministic state

client_server.authority: server is authoritative for all mana operations and state
client_server.integration_seam: Pure Java class with no Minecraft/Fabric dependencies; can be used by mod code on either side but server owns the authoritative instance

acceptance_criteria: ManaAPI.java is a final class with private constructor (non-instantiable)
All public methods are static and match the exact signatures specified
getMana delegates to ChunkManaMap.get and returns correct values
setMana delegates to ChunkManaMap.set and maintains sparsity
addMana delegates to ChunkManaMap.add and handles edge cases
gatherMana delegates to SphericalGatherer.gather with correct parameters
flowMana delegates to FlowEngine.flowPair with correct parameters
getConfig/setConfig manages a singleton ManaConfig with validation
All methods compile with pure Java (no Minecraft or Fabric imports)
Class uses only existing pure Java components (ChunkManaMap, ManaConfig, etc.)
ManaAPITest.java contains executable tests verifying all public API contracts

verifier_cases.description: setMana then getMana returns the set value
setMana with non-positive value removes position
addMana with positive delta increases value
addMana that would go negative clamps to 0
addMana with NaN delta is ignored
verifier_cases.input: setMana(0,0,0, 10.0) then addMana(0,0,0, Double.NaN) then getMana(0,0,0)

verifier_cases.description: gatherMana collects from single position within radius
flowMana moves from higher to lower concentration
getConfig returns non-null config with valid defaults
setConfig then getConfig returns the set config
All operations work correctly with negative coordinates

rationale: The ManaAPI facade is the critical integration point referenced in ARCHITECTURE.md that enables mod developers to interact with the mana system. It advances PRODUCT.md by providing the 'API for mods to register custom consumers/creators', 'API for mods to query mana at positions', and 'API for mods to modify mana at positions'. As a pure Java class delegating to existing components (ChunkManaMap, SphericalGatherer, FlowEngine, ManaConfig), it can be implemented and tested in isolation without Minecraft/Fabric/Gradle dependencies. This is the smallest coherent MVP increment that unifies all previously implemented pure Java components into a single, testable public API surface.
